description: Representative seed of REAL programmes transcribed from the TCU 2026/27 Bachelor's Degree Admission Guidebook (inputs/tcu-undergraduate-admission-guidebook-2026-2027.pdf). Structured rules in 'slots'; conditions outside A-level scope (O-level etc.) are kept visible in 'additional_requirements' but not machine-evaluated in the MVP. Checklist fields with null = data not yet available (never invented).

programmes.name: Doctor of Medicine
programmes.requirement_text: Three principal passes in Physics, Chemistry and Biology with minimum of 6 points. A minimum of 'D' grade in Chemistry, Biology and Physics.

checklist.what_is_it: Trains medical doctors (clinical medicine).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science with Education
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in the following subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography, Advanced Mathematics or Computer Science.

checklist.what_is_it: Prepares secondary-school science teachers.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Information Technology Application and Management
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in the following subjects: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition.

checklist.what_is_it: Applied IT: using and managing technology in organisations.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Environmental Health
programmes.requirement_text: Three principal passes in Chemistry, Biology and either Physics or Mathematics or Nutrition or Geography or Agriculture with a minimum of 6 points. A minimum of 'C' grade in Chemistry and D grade in Biology and at least E grade in the third subject.

checklist.what_is_it: Public/environmental health: sanitation, disease prevention, inspection.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in Advanced Mathematics/Computer Science and in one of the following subjects: Geography, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, or Biology.

checklist.what_is_it: Programming, algorithms, software and systems (Ahmad's course!).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts with Education
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in the following subjects: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language or Arabic.

checklist.what_is_it: Prepares secondary-school arts/humanities teachers.

programmes.name: Bachelor Degree in Accounting and Finance
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in the following subjects: History, Geography, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Kiswahili, English.

checklist.what_is_it: Accounting, financial reporting and finance for organisations.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Pharmacy
programmes.institution: Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS)
programmes.requirement_text: Three principal passes at grade 'C' in Chemistry, Biology, and Physics or Mathematics.
additional_requirements: Preference to candidates with grade 'B' in Chemistry, then Biology. Candidates with 'D' in Physics/Mathematics may be considered if they have 'B' in Chemistry and/or Biology.

checklist.what_is_it: Medicines: their science, preparation and safe use.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Environmental Health
programmes.institution: Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS)
programmes.requirement_text: Three principal passes in Chemistry, Biology, and either Physics, Nutrition, Geography, or Agriculture with a minimum of 6 points.
additional_requirements: Candidates with a 'C' grade in Chemistry given high priority.

checklist.what_is_it: Public/environmental health at Tanzania's leading health university.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Diagnostic and Therapeutic Radiography
programmes.institution: Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS)
programmes.requirement_text: Three principal passes at grade 'D' in Physics, Biology, and Chemistry with a pass in Mathematics.
additional_requirements: Requires a pass in Mathematics. Preference to grade 'C' in Physics, then Biology; 'E' in Physics or a pass in Mathematics may be considered with 'C' in Biology and/or Chemistry.

checklist.what_is_it: Medical imaging (X-ray, ultrasound, radiotherapy).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Archaeology
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal level passes in History, Language, Geography, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Advanced Mathematics.
additional_requirements: Guidebook lists 'Language' generically; all language subjects accepted here.

checklist.what_is_it: Study of human history through excavation and material remains.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Economics
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes one of which must be in Economics or Advanced Mathematics.
additional_requirements: Candidates without Advanced Mathematics must have a credit pass or above in Basic Mathematics at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: How economies work: markets, policy, development.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in History and Archives Management
programmes.requirement_text: Principal pass in History at 'D' or above and a principal pass from: English, Kiswahili, Chinese, Economics, Geography, Fine Arts, French or Arabic.

checklist.what_is_it: History plus managing archives and records.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Language Studies
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes, one of which must be a minimum of 'C' grade in: English Language, Kiswahili, French, Chinese or Arabic.

checklist.what_is_it: Linguistics and language: how languages work and are used.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Literature
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes one of which must be at 'C' grade or above in Kiswahili, English or French.

checklist.what_is_it: Literature: reading, criticism and creative traditions.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and Public Administration
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in the following subjects: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English (and related arts subjects).
additional_requirements: Requirement text truncated in extraction; subject list slightly conservative.

checklist.what_is_it: Politics, governance and public administration.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Mining Engineering
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in Advanced Mathematics and Physics.
additional_requirements: Applicant without at least a subsidiary pass in Chemistry must have a minimum of 'C' grade at O-Level. Special requirement: physical fitness.

checklist.what_is_it: Engineering for mineral extraction — a major Tanzanian industry.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Textile Engineering
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal level passes in Advanced Mathematics or Physics and in one of: Chemistry, Geography, Biology or Computer Science.
additional_requirements: Without subsidiary pass in Chemistry at A-level: at least 'C' in Chemistry at O-level. Without principal Advanced Mathematics: at least 'C' in Mathematics at O-level.

checklist.what_is_it: Engineering of textile production and materials.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Agricultural Engineering
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in Advanced Mathematics and one of: Physics, Chemistry, or Geography.
additional_requirements: Must have a minimum of 'D' grade in Physics, Chemistry and Biology at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: Engineering applied to farming: irrigation, machinery, processing.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Agriculture
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in Biology and one of the following: Chemistry, Physics or Agriculture.

checklist.what_is_it: Crop and animal production science — agriculture employs most Tanzanians.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Architecture
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in any of: Advanced Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography, Computer Science or Fine Arts.
additional_requirements: At least a subsidiary pass in Advanced/Basic Applied Mathematics at A-level, or minimum 'C' in Basic Mathematics at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: Designing buildings — art meets engineering.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Accounting
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Chinese, Arabic, Fine Art, Physical Education, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition.
additional_requirements: Those without a principal/subsidiary pass in Advanced Mathematics or a pass in Basic Applied Mathematics must have a credit in Mathematics at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: Professional accounting at Tanzania's finance-focused institute.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Banking and Finance
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Chinese, Arabic, Fine Art, Physical Education, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition.
additional_requirements: Those without a principal/subsidiary pass in Advanced Mathematics or a pass in Basic Applied Mathematics must have a credit in Mathematics at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: Banking operations and financial services.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes, one in Physics, Chemistry or Advanced Mathematics and one in: Biology, Geography, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition.
additional_requirements: Those without a principal/subsidiary pass in Advanced Mathematics or a pass in Basic Applied Mathematics must have a credit in Mathematics at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: IT systems with a finance-sector orientation.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Insurance and Risk Management
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Chinese, Arabic, Fine Art, Physical Education, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition.

checklist.what_is_it: Insurance, actuarial basics and organisational risk.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Public Sector Accounting and Finance
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition, and one subsidiary.
additional_requirements: If no principal pass in Advanced Mathematics, Economics, Accountancy, Chemistry or Physics: must have a subsidiary pass in Basic Applied Mathematics at A-level AND minimum 'C' in Mathematics, Book-Keeping or Physics at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: Accounting and finance for government and public institutions.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws (LL.B)
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition, and one subsidiary.
additional_requirements: Those without principal or subsidiary passes in English and History must have minimum 'C' grade in English and History at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: Law degree — route to advocacy, corporate counsel, judiciary.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Public Administration
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition, and one subsidiary at A-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: Managing public institutions and policy implementation.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws (LL.B)
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in: History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition.
additional_requirements: Applicants without principal passes in History and English must meet the stated O-Level conditions (see guidebook).

checklist.what_is_it: Law at Tanzania's oldest law faculty.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Interior Design
programmes.requirement_text: Two principal passes in any of: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Geography, Computer Science or Fine Arts.
additional_requirements: At least a subsidiary pass in Advanced/Basic Applied Mathematics at A-level, or minimum 'C' in Basic Mathematics at O-Level.

checklist.what_is_it: Designing interior spaces: aesthetics, function, materials.
